result.instructions: Faber builds solids through stdio MCP. Call open with path and create:true, then put_part or put_parts. A part has a name, colour [R,G,B], geometry {op:extrude, profile:{outer:[[x,y],...],holes:[...]},height}, and optional placement {translation:[x,y,z],rotation:[x,y,z]}. For a solid with a closed floor, use op:pocket with the same profile and height plus floor in millimetres; the holes stop at the floor. Number fields accept a number or an expression string. Use set_param with name and expression to set a shared parameter; params returns expressions and values. Functions use degrees. Coordinates are millimetres. Angles are degrees. Z is up. Profiles are closed without a repeated last point. Rotations apply X, then Y, then Z. Part ids contain letters, digits, underscores or hyphens. Changes build before save. A failed change leaves the project unchanged. Call status to inspect bounds and volume. Call export to write one mesh per part. Call render with a path to get an image; optional section has normal:[x,y,z], offset in millimetres and reverse. Renderer images do not change the solids. The separate viewer watches the same project. For ordered operations, use geometry {op:history,features:[{id,geometry},...],output:id}. Features can use box {size:[x,y,z]}, cylinder {radius,height}, extrude, pocket, transform {source,placement}, union, difference or intersection {left,right}. References name earlier feature ids. Use part_info to read the recipe. Use add_feature, edit_feature, delete_feature and move_feature to change a history. Source recipes remain editable.

tools.description: Insert a feature before an id, or append it. Set make_output to use its solid as the part output.

rotation.description: Rotate about X, then Y, then Z.

tools.name: add_feature

tools.description: Apply ordered design edits as one transaction. Build the final state once. Any failure refuses the whole batch. Each operation has a tool field and its arguments.

rotation.description: Rotate about X, then Y, then Z.

tools.name: batch

tools.description: Save the current design under a unique name. Names are case insensitive.
tools.name: checkpoint

tools.description: Delete a feature. Refuse deletion if a later operation or the output still needs it.
tools.name: delete_feature

tools.description: Replace a feature operation and rebuild its dependent results before save.

rotation.description: Rotate about X, then Y, then Z.

tools.name: edit_feature

tools.description: Write one file per part. Choose stl for meshes or step for exact solids. Units are millimetres.
tools.name: export

tools.description: Read the modelling guide.
tools.name: guide

tools.description: Move a feature before an id, or to the end. Refuse an order with invalid dependencies.
tools.name: move_feature

tools.description: Open a project. Set create to true to create a project if it does not exist.
tools.name: open

tools.description: Read shared parameter expressions and calculated values.
tools.name: params

tools.description: Read a part recipe, ordered features, placement, bounds and volume.
tools.name: part_info

tools.description: Add or replace a part. Build the solid before saving the project.

rotation.description: Rotate about X, then Y, then Z.

tools.name: put_part

tools.description: Add or replace several parts as one change. Refuse the whole change if any solid fails.

rotation.description: Rotate about X, then Y, then Z.

tools.name: put_parts

tools.description: Redo a saved change after undo. A new edit clears the redo branch.
tools.name: redo

tools.description: Remove a part by its id.
tools.name: remove_part

tools.description: Render the model without a window. An optional section cuts the view and fills the cut faces. Source geometry stays unchanged.
tools.name: render

tools.description: Restore a named checkpoint. Build before save. Undo can reverse this change.
tools.name: restore

tools.description: Set a shared parameter expression. Rebuild affected solids before save.
tools.name: set_param

tools.description: Read part bounds, volume and triangle counts.
tools.name: status

tools.description: Read exact edges and faces of a placed part. Indices are valid only for the returned revision. Feature selectors use source feature coordinates.
tools.name: topology

tools.description: Undo the last saved change. Refuse if the current file differs from its recorded state.
tools.name: undo
